assumptions.statement: A Base-1 screen floor plus 5 additive stimulus dimensions (0-2 pts each, capped at 10) provides an interpretable parent screening proxy for audiovisual and interactive overstimulation.
assumptions.verification_plan: Calibrate SEM-10 tier cutoffs (Low 1-3, Moderate 4-6, High 7-10) against blinded pediatric developmental ratings across n >= 50 children's shows and games.

assumptions.statement: Scene-cut pacing thresholds (>15s low, 5-15s moderate, <4s high) generalize from preschool fast-paced cartoon executive-function studies (Lillard & Peterson 2011) to interactive tablet games.
assumptions.verification_plan: Measure post-session inhibitory control and frustration tolerance following 15-minute exposures to Low-tier vs. High-tier interactive games.

assumptions.statement: Static client-side whitelisting and DNS/OS lockdown guides reduce accidental algorithmic rabbit-hole drift without requiring server-side user accounts or telemetry collection.
assumptions.verification_plan: Conduct usability walkthroughs with 20 parent households configuring FreeTube/KidzTV and NextDNS/Control D from the portal's exported JSON/CSV allow-lists.

assumptions.statement: YouTube channel handles and curated game store availability remain stable across regional storefronts between quarterly repository audits.
assumptions.verification_plan: Run an out-of-band quarterly link-health and monetization re-verification audit against all 28 channel URLs and 33 game entries.
